verdict.rationale: ObsessionDB's own site describes CHKit as giving agents "typed commands to describe, validate, test, and deploy schema and pipelines as code" that an agent can drive in CI. That reads as a first-party command-line tool aimed at agentic workflows, but the evidence never explicitly calls it a CLI and covers only schema and pipeline work. missing for 10: explicit confirmation that CHKit is an official CLI with install and command-reference docs, CLI coverage of service, cluster or query management beyond schema and pipelines, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
